probes.check: am_probe_enkits_jobs(): jobs submitted through the jobs interface run on enkiTS's task threads.

seeded_violation.description: Run each submitted job on the submitting thread instead of handing it to enkiTS.

adaptation_notes: enkiTS fills the jobs slot: the jobs interface's am_jobs_slot_start, am_jobs_slot_submit, am_jobs_slot_run_one and am_jobs_slot_stop run on its scheduler, which the jobs phase initializes with the configured worker count and stops after every job finishes.
Each submitted job becomes an enki::ITaskSet freed once it completes; enkiTS doesn't touch a completed task without dependents.
A thread outside enkiTS that submits registers as one of its external task threads the first time, up to eight.
